# glinet_ddns (Resource)

Manages the dynamic DNS (DDNS) service of GL.iNet on the router. The router has one DDNS configuration, so use one instance of this resource. When DDNS is enabled, the router registers its name and its public address with the GL.iNet DDNS service. DDNS does not open access to the router over the WAN. Destroy disables DDNS on the router, so that the router does not keep a public name after the resource is removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_ddns" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether DDNS is enabled (`enable_ddns` in the router API).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `ddns`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "ddns".
terraform import glinet_ddns.this ddns
```
